scope: Exact native-resolved XModel name/provenance catalog for the source-available Steam English FastFile subset
proofBoundary: Every name-catalog occurrence is inherited from a closed per-zone native XModel identity report from authoritative run 34164196686.
Names are grouped only by exact case-sensitive native XModel name strings. No fuzzy normalization, prefix matching, adjacency, visual similarity, or semantic-name inference is used.
The 14473 count is the number of distinct native name strings represented by the 22255 source-available occurrences, not a proof that same-name payloads in different zones are byte-identical.
The 3009 names repeated across zones are retained as repeated-name provenance. Cross-zone payload byte identity remains a separate proof problem.
The 82 source-unavailable English-retail FastFiles remain outside this catalog and continue to block whole-English-retail XModel completeness.
This catalog itself makes no character, weapon, vehicle, prop, map, animation, material, texture, TechniqueSet, shader, or export-fidelity classification claim.
